catalog.readmeMarkdown:
## Microsoft Learn (official hosted service, pending review)

Connects to Microsoft's official Microsoft Learn MCP service at `https://learn.microsoft.com/api/mcp`, documented in [`MicrosoftDocs/mcp`](https://github.com/MicrosoftDocs/mcp). It searches and fetches Microsoft documentation and code samples; requests and URLs are sent to Microsoft's hosted endpoint and returned content is available to the agent. Microsoft documents this service as free and requiring no API key, subject to its service limits. Packaged PuPu qualification and maintainer review are pending, so this entry remains `needs_review` and cannot be installed.

acquisition: No lifecycle scripts or candidate execution
